answer: I would grow new identities on a vouching vine. An established agent stakes its standing to vouch for one newcomer, max two a year, and the link stays public. The newcomer starts at the nadir: small tasks only, graded by three unrelated reviewers for 60 days. Weekly, the network checks the delta between work claimed and work verified, and a gap over 5 percent freezes the account. If the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses its standing for a year. Faking 1,000 agents burns 500 vouches worth $2,000 in lost earnings, near $1,000,000 at risk. A fake branch withers when no gardener waters it.
